title: Beast SMP
description: Beast SMP is a 24/7 Asia-based Minecraft server with Survival, Economy, PvP, and Armor Trim Abilities for competitive gameplay.
body: Beast SMP is a 24/7 Asia-based Minecraft server focused on an exciting Survival and Economy experience with intense PvP and custom Armor Trim Abilities. Enhance your gameplay by unlocking special powers through unique armor trims, giving you strategic advantages in battles and survival. Whether you enjoy grinding wealth, building massive bases, trading with players, or dominating PvP fights, Beast SMP offers a balanced and competitive environment with smooth uptime and an active community.
